HotUpdate patch assets

8,591 images from the game's StreamingAssets/HotUpdate — content patched in after the base install, so none of it is in the AssetBundles dump. Bundle filenames are numeric hashes, so the only way to find anything is by asset name; the hash is on each tile and is searchable.
